question: Related Questions Q. Using collection money to give Imam as hadiya or gift during Ramazan 8212 views Q. We would like to ask a Shari Ruling regarding rent for a Madrasah which is based at an Islamic Secondary school building, the Islamic Secondary school building was opened by the current Chairman and the current Vice Chairman (a committee was later made on the bases that they would be supportive). Currently the Madrasah uses three classes in the evening for Madrasah. The Madrasah currently pay?s rent. But the issue has arisen about rent for the Madrasah when it first opened in 2004. Before the Madrasah opened, eminent scholars gave Mushwerah that the building was not used in the evenings and it would be suitable for evening Madrasah, through this it was then decided by the Chairman that the building can be used without any rent being paid, this was due to the Madrasah being new and to get the Madrasah running, at this time none of the Governors of the school were active in the daily issues of the school. From 2006 due to some issues (regarding the Islamic Secondary school) the Governors of the school got involved and they raised the issue of rent and they decided that rent should be back dated to (2004) and paid to the date of when payment first started (which was 2006). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 13972 Country: United Kingdom Title: AA. about rebuild of very old and small masjid. for the many reason have to replaced and rebuilded a new big mosque nearby old mosque (approx 3 fit far).after demolish the old mosque land is empty now and next to busy road is it parmissible to do some shops on this empty land for the benefit of the mosque? massalam Question: AA. about rebuild of very old and small masjid. for the many reason have to replaced and rebuilded a new big mosque nearby old mosque (approx 3 fit far).after demolish the old mosque land is empty now and next to busy road is it parmissible to do some shops on this empty land for the benefit of the mosque? massalam Answer ID: 13972 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 992/992=M/1430) After demolishing the old mosque, the mosque was rebuilt by leaving three feet area, so if the left area was a part of Sharai Mosque, it was unlawful exclude it from mosque and construct shop etc over it. A portion of land, once included in Sharai mosque, will always remain mosque and it will be unlawful and haram to dislodge it as mosque. Yes, if the portion (3 feet) was already out of Sharai mosque, so for the interests of the mosque, shops etc can be constructed there with mutual consultation and consult the local Ulama for observation and survey. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
